description: Buyer types a short requirement in plain words; AI proposes values for these RFQ form fields. Nothing is saved automatically: the user must review and apply.

fields.label: Category
fields.note: Must be one of the slugs sent in request.categories

fields.label: Delivery pincode
fields.note: Only if the pincode is written in the text

fields.label: Target price
fields.reason: Commercial decision of the buyer; AI never proposes prices

fields.label: Buyer name
fields.reason: Prefill from the logged-in profile, not AI

fields.label: Buyer email
fields.reason: Prefill from the logged-in profile, not AI

fields.label: Buyer company
fields.reason: Prefill from the logged-in profile, not AI
